reviews.rationale: The deployed fixture is 150 B above target with 3,946 B of hard-limit margin; its typed and provenance-bound transactions, monotonic deadlines, Search ROM framing, and release-confirmed rollback are required deterministic evidence.

The attribution build deliberately disables LTO and jump tables for exact stack and map evidence; it retains 2,220 B of hard-limit margin, and removing transaction, correlation, deadline, or rollback paths would weaken the approved deterministic contract.

The padding-free object owns the complete configuration and snapshot, exact receipt correlation, monotonic and deadline anchors, and lifecycle, phase, and search state; its 2 B hard margin imposes zero growth and requires fresh review after any ABI change.
